updates.problem: RAKL lacked an executable contract for importing atomic operators from external research frameworks without inheriting unsupported authority or forcing incompatible methods into one workflow.
updates.implementation: MethodOperatorContract + AssimilationEvidence + evaluate_method_assimilation with explicit may_mint/must_not_mint authority envelope, transition-map identity, provenance, negative-history check, equivalence dedup and parallel-local-view verdict.
updates.activation_boundary: The evaluator only decides shadow eligibility/equivalence/parallel view/block/reject/cannot-check. It has no ACTIVE verdict and cannot change routing or main by itself.
updates.remaining_gap: Real external components have not yet been run head-to-head under matched tasks and budgets.

updates.problem: Synthetic contract worlds establish conformance but do not show that governed assimilation outperforms simple or fixed pipelines on real research operators.
updates.target: Instantiate matched operators from retrieval, claim-evidence linking, falsification, formal verification, memory and experiment search frameworks; compare uncontrolled aggregation, fixed curation and RAKL contextual assimilation.

updates.problem: The current support module records whether a transition witness was externally verified but does not itself verify semantic preservation across schemas, units, assumptions or authority layers.
updates.target: Define typed transition witnesses and hostile composition cases, reusing GLUE/JUMP witness algebra where appropriate without conflating method equivalence with scientific analogy.

updates.new_projection: Scientific skill repositories increasingly expose version pinning and provenance metadata; assimilated operators should bind source version and transitive dependency identity before reproducibility authority is claimed.

new_prior_art: SkillOps typed skill contracts and ecosystem maintenance
SkillFoundry validated scientific skill mining and lifecycle
HASP executable skill programs and validated evolution
SkillSmith skill-tool co-evolution and anti-pattern memory
S1-NexusAgent dynamic scientific tool retrieval and trajectory-to-skill distillation
updates.consequence: The paper must not claim modular skill fusion, typed skill contracts, self-evolving skills, dynamic tool routing, or anti-pattern memory individually. Novelty review targets RAKL's scientific authority envelope plus contextual transition/parallel-view governance.
